description:
Variation of
condition 2 (Approved Plans) attached to planning permission PL/3353/24 dated 05/06/2025 to allow alterations to the layout, boundary treatment and materials.
decision_conditions: <p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">The flats hereby permitted shall be used for Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</p><p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt"><br></p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">The development hereby permitted shall be completed before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/3353/24 dated 05/06/2025.</p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">Refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage area as shown on the approved plans, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any part of the development is occupied or used.</p>
<p>MAT_MATCH: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.<br></p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">The development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until details of the secure cycle parking to serve each of the flats has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be put in place prior to the first occupation of the development in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">The development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The boundary treatment as so agreed shall be completed prior to the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until works for the disposal of sewage have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until works for the disposal of surface water have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents submitted with this application:</p><p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">21023-WolseleyRoad-10-902 (Proposed Ground Floor Plan)</p><p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">21023-WolseleyRoad-10-903 (Proposed First Floor, Second Floor and Roof Plans); and,</p><p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">21023-WolseleyRoad-10-904 (Proposed Elevations).</p>

<p style="padding:0cm 5.4pt 0cm 5.4pt">The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the forecourt of the site. Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers / densities.<br></p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">All planting, seeding or turfing shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the approved building or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">No window(s) / door(s) shall be installed in the flank wall(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p>

<p style="padding: 0cm 5.4pt;">The roof area of the single storey front extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.</p>
